SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS helsinki_date,
       COUNT(*) AS all_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled') AS not_cancelled,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled') AS distinct_not_cancelled,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'processing') AS processing,
       CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS utc_date_dummy
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-29' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-03'
GROUP BY 1, 8 ORDER BY 1, 8

WITH day_orders AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.member_key, o.login_state
  FROM fact_web_order o
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
),
test_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test' AND f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM day_orders)
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM day_orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled') AS not_cancelled,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM day_orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND web_order_id IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM test_orders)) AS test_orders_in_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM day_orders WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM day_orders WHERE status = 'processing') AS processing,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM day_orders WHERE login_state='guest') AS guests,
       (SELECT MAX(CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)) FROM fact_web_order) AS max_order_date
